data.name: Favored Terrain (Water)
data.description: You gain a +%1 bonus on Knowledge (Geography), Perception, Stealth, and Survival checks when using these skills above or below the water surface. Likewise, you get a +%1 bonus on initiative checks when in this terrain. If you desire, you leave no trail in this terrain and cannot be tracked.|FavoredTerrainWater
